title: After the Kikuka Sho: What's the Right Way?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Mejiro McQueen claims victory at the Kikuka Sho. Overwhelmed with happiness, tears of joy run down her face.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Seeing that, Mejiro Palmer questions whether or not she herself has that kind of passion for running.
